title: Microservices Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) Architecture
description: A Backend-for-Frontend architecture diagram with separate BFF layers for web and mobile clients, each optimizing API responses for their specific platform while sharing common backend microservices. This template shows how to avoid one-size-fits-all APIs by tailoring data aggregation and payload optimization per client type. Recommended for teams serving multiple frontend platforms from a shared microservices backend.
